rows.en:
Heh heh heh heh...
He jumped from right above this very window.
Heh heh heh heh...
What appeared outside the window just now may have been Yoshino's ghost, killing himself over and over again.
Do you pity him...?
But you mustn't feel sorry for him.
It's Yoshino's own fault for making Yuya angry.{p}

Heh, do be careful.
Careful not to anger me, or to trouble me...
Heh heh heh...
Well, that's the end of my story.
Whose turn is it next, I wonder...?{p}

...Oh, are you flustered now?
Heh heh heh, you'd be in trouble if you couldn't hear about the seven wonders, wouldn't you?
Fine.
You needn't smile for me.
I've completely lost any wish to talk...
Would you hurry along to the next person?{p}

Heh heh heh...
The truth is, quite a few boys are fond of you.
Those boys tell me,
"{b} {a} in Class 1-E has the best smile!"
...I hear it all the time, you see...
To tell the truth, I was looking forward to meeting you today.
...Well?{p}Will you smile for me?

Yes, a sweet smile, just like that...
...Thank you.
Heh heh heh...
It was a lovely smile, just as the rumors said.{p}

Heh heh, just as I thought...
You're so very pretty, after all.
Men would never leave you alone, would they?
Heh heh heh...
But I'm sure a great many people will be disappointed.
It seems lots of them think you're still available.
...Not that it's anything for you to worry about.
The only one you need to think about is your beloved sweetheart...
Heh heh heh...
If you call someone your sweetheart, then you must love that person, mustn't you?
It would be strange otherwise.
You can't call someone you don't love your 'sweetheart.'
Isn't that right?{p}
Heh heh heh...{p}He's terribly devoted to his practice.

Heh heh heh...
My recommendation would be Mr. Kawaguchi, the art teacher.
He isn't very sociable, but he's what you might call an artist...{p}I'm sure you'll be moved when you see him at work on a painting.

Heh heh heh...
There's no need to worry.
You'll find someone wonderful soon enough.
Someone who will love you more than anyone else in this world.{p}

Heh heh heh...
He's quite a catch.
If there's anything you don't understand in class or in your homework, you should have him teach you.
He explains things very patiently.
Yes, he's terribly smart.
After all, he's been attending this school for a very long time.
Heh heh heh...
When Takashima was a student, the war was on, so he could hardly study at all.
He died in an air raid, without ever getting to read the books he loved.
He wanted to study more...
Because that regret stayed behind, he still appears in the library.
Even now that he's become a ghost...... you see.{p}

"Heh heh heh...
{a}, the two of you make such a lovely couple."
Even Iwashita's gleeful voice sounded far away, as if it were echoing.
It was hard even to stay on my feet...{p}

"My, my, worn out already...
Well, he's sucking out your life force, so it can't be helped.
But at this rate, I wonder how many more hours your life will last.
Heh heh heh...
If only there were a candle that could measure your lifespan."{p}

You seem unsure.
Maybe you don't need a sweetheart just yet, {a}.
Heh heh heh...
There's no need to worry.
You'll find someone wonderful soon enough.
Someone who will love you more than anyone else in this world.{p}

Heh heh, I see.
So right now your love is one-sided.
Tell me, {a}...
The person you like must be someone wonderful.{p}If you don't mind... won't you tell me that person's name?

Heh heh heh...
You probably can't believe it, hearing something like this so suddenly...
Yes, let me tell you the story."
With a meaningful smile, Iwashita began to speak, haltingly.{p}

Seeing me like that, Iwashita giggled.
"My, {a}...
There's no need to be shy.
Heh heh heh heh...
I hope your feelings come true.
I hope that person becomes the best sweetheart you could ever have..."{p}

Heh heh heh...
Oh, {a}, you still look like you can't believe it.
But it's all right, isn't it?
After all, you nodded just now to say you believe me.{p}

Heh heh heh...
{a}...
You may be in danger too, you know.
Because anyone who gets involved with me ends up in danger.{p}

Heh heh heh...
...Thank you.
You should have a love like this too, {a}.
He keeps me bound to him because he loves me that much...{p}

Heh heh, he's very angry indeed.
You'd better be careful, {a}...
You're... in danger.
Don't blame me if something horrible happens to you.
Anyway, my story ends here.
Heh heh heh...
I hope you make it safely to the very last story.
Now, let's hurry on to the next one......{p}

Heh heh heh...
There was a reason I told you this story, you know.
Today is Yuya's memorial: three years since he died.
And it's the day he promised he'd come back...
He was a truly sincere man.
So he's bound to come back.
Back to me...{p}

You'd better remember this.
I will never forgive you.
I'll make you taste the same sorrow I've felt!"
"Iwashita..."
"Heh heh, I have nothing more to say to you.
Why don't you hurry on to the next one?"{p}

What's the reflection room, you ask?
Hee hee, hang on a sec.
...Let's go into that classroom over there.
See, nobody uses it now, but it used to be the reflection room.{p}

Heh heh, I'll kill you too.
Together with Fukuzawa, in the reflection room.
Or would you rather follow Arai?
You were supposed to be killed by the Mummy Man in the video, weren't you?
Hahahahaha, hahahahahaha..............{p}

"Who are you?"
"Me?
Heh heh, does it matter who I am?"
"......"{p}

"I was talking it over with the president...
I know I can leave the newspaper club in your hands.
I'm lucky to have such a dependable junior."
...What'll I do if he says something like that?
Being president is a big role, way too much for me...
But turning it down would ruffle feathers, wouldn't it?
President {a}...
That sounds pretty cool, doesn't it?
......Or am I getting ahead of myself?
Hee hee hee...{p}

"I heard about you too.
Let me see... Your name is Sakagami, isn't it?"
...What★
W-wait a minute!
"Hee hee hee hee...
I'm so pleased.
To think the one who came to interview us would be such a lovely boy."{p}

"Come on, music!
......Zun-taka-tat-ta, tan-ta-tan.
Tan-tan-tat-tan, hm-hm-hmm-hm......"
Humming a dubious tune, Kazama started doing some sloppy dance steps.
As I watched in a daze, he twirled round and round to the right, to the left, then hopped and bounced.
Nozomu Kazama......
A great man, in more ways than one.
I tried to quietly slip away.
And then...{p}
